recognize_zh: 中央一顆嗜中性球大小正常、細胞質有細小粉紫顆粒，但核是單一橢圓形未分葉，染色質粗糙結塊；核成熟卻不分葉，是 Pelger-Huët 異常中圓核型（Stodtmeister cell）的表現。
features: Neutrophil of normal size with a single oval, non-segmented nucleus
Very coarse, clumped mature chromatin with pale parachromatin spaces
Abundant pale cytoplasm with fine specific (neutrophilic) granules
Normochromic red cells and a polychromatic cell in background
describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with a single round-to-oval, non-lobulated nucleus. The chromatin is coarsely clumped, indicating maturity despite absent segmentation, and the cytoplasm contains normal fine neutrophilic granules. Background red cells are normochromic with an occasional polychromatic cell. Findings are consistent with a hyposegmented neutrophil of Pelger-Huët type (round-nucleus form), which requires correlation with the rest of the smear to distinguish inherited from acquired (pseudo-Pelger) change.

ddx.vs: A myelocyte has a round nucleus but finer, less condensed chromatin and often a paranuclear clear zone, reflecting immaturity.
Lymphocytes lack the fine neutrophilic cytoplasmic granules and have scant, bluer cytoplasm.
Dysplastic hyposegmented neutrophils are often hypogranular and accompany other dysplastic lineages and cytopenias.
